heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 97–164, title I, § 113, Apr. 2, 1982, 96 Stat. 29]

notes.text: Section, acts June 25, 1948, ch. 646, 62 Stat. 906; May 24, 1949, ch. 139, § 70, 63 Stat. 100, provided for distribution of copies of decisions of Court of Claims. See section 174(b) of this title.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective Oct. 1, 1982, see section 402 of Pub. L. 97–164, set out as an Effective Date of 1982 Amendment note under section 171 of this title.
